newsitem.title: USA: HORSE RACING-POST POSTITIONS FOR PREAKNESS STAKES.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-POST POSTITIONS FOR PREAKNESS STAKES.

text.p: 122nd running of the Preakness Stakes -- second leg of
thoroughbred racing's Triple Crown -- following Wednesday's
draw (tabulate under post position, horse, jockey, trainer,
1. Jack at the Bank Herb McCauley, Alfredo Callejas, 50-1
2. Wild Tempest Joe Bravo, Nick Zito, 20-1
4. Free House Kent Desormeaux, Paco Gonzalez, 9-2
5. Touch Gold Chris McCarron, David Hofmans, 5-1
7. Silver Charm Gary Stevens, Bob Baffert, 9-5
8. Frisk Me Now Eddie King, Bob Durso, 15-1
9. Captain Bodgit Alex Solis, Gary Capuano, 2-1
10. Cryp Too C.C Lopez, Allen Borosh, 30-1
Note: Race for three-year-olds is over 1-3/16 miles,
